about.title: Holistic care, rooted in Porur
body: Amrutha Multi Speciality Homoeopathic Clinic and Counselling Centre was founded on a simple belief — that health is more than the absence of illness, and that the mind and body deserve to be cared for together, not separately.

We offer classical homoeopathic consultations for chronic and everyday conditions, alongside professional counselling for stress, anxiety, and relationship concerns, all delivered with the time and attention each patient deserves.
Our BHMS-qualified physician and experienced counsellor work closely together so that patients dealing with both physical and emotional concerns don't have to explain their story twice.

blogPosts.title: How Homoeopathy and Counselling Can Work Together for Chronic Stress
blogPosts.excerpt: Chronic stress rarely shows up as just one thing — here's how a combined homoeopathic and counselling approach can offer more complete support.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Lakshmi Narayanan
content: Chronic stress has a way of showing up in more than one place at once — as tension headaches or skin flare-ups on one hand, and as racing thoughts or trouble sleeping on the other. Treating only the physical symptoms, or only the emotional ones, often means missing half the picture.

At Amrutha Multi Speciality Homoeopathic Clinic and Counselling Centre, we see this regularly: a patient comes in for a persistent skin condition, and it turns out the flare-ups track closely with a particularly stressful stretch at work or at home.

This is where having both homoeopathic care and counselling support under one roof becomes genuinely useful. A homoeopathic consultation focuses on gentle, individualised support for the physical symptoms, while counselling sessions give the patient a structured space to work through the underlying stress itself.

Neither approach claims to be a quick fix, and we're careful not to overpromise — homoeopathy and counselling are both about supporting the body and mind's own capacity to manage and adapt, not about instant cures.
If you've noticed your physical symptoms seem to track with stressful periods in your life, it may be worth discussing both sides of the picture with us at your next visit.
